subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith was feasting, not hunting, and that this distinction mattered to his continued good health.
source_quote: The wraith was at the entrance to the Greater Temple when we arrived. Feasting. Not hunting. Feasting, which is a distinction that mattered to my continued good health.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recalled the last time he stood close to the wraith and came away with something missing — not a wound, but a portion of himself the cold reached into and found worth keeping.
source_quote: The last time I'd stood this close to him, I'd come away with something missing: not a wound exactly, more like a portion of myself that the cold reached into and found worth keeping.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr appreciated Calmer's energy but had learned not to rely on it as a tactical plan.
source_quote: I appreciate the energy. I have learned not to rely on it as a tactical plan.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith was no longer performing menace but something closer to collegial warmth after being acknowledged and asked what it knew.
source_quote: I could feel the room tilt: the wraith no longer performing menace but something closer to collegial warmth. Peer to peer. I'd given it an audience.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had raised seven specters from bodies the party was responsible for killing.
source_quote: Seven specters. Raised from bodies we were responsible for.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believed the wraith was building something and wanted to make sure it built it for them.
source_quote: Good, I thought. The wraith is building something. We need to make sure it builds it for us.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asked the wraith who the Greater Temple was, and learned it was the deep temple — the people who are really in charge.
source_quote: The Greater Temple," the wraith said, "is the deep temple. It's the people who are really in charge.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr had been wrong about who sat at the top before — Romag, then Hartsch, then them — and now understood the ceiling kept rising.
source_quote: Every time I thought I'd found the ceiling, another one appeared above it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asked the voice behind the door how to meet the people in charge, and was told to survive the fight.
source_quote: Survive the fight, and maybe you'll get a chance.

subject: Zephyr's understanding of leadership
fact: Zephyr recognized that leadership in this war was being passed around like a burden no one wanted to hold.
source_quote: I thought: nobody in this room wants to hold the thing they're holding.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had become confident the outcome was already decided and was merely permitting time to catch up.
source_quote: He meant it warmly. The absolute confidence of something that has already decided the outcome and is merely permitting time to catch up.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia counted the soldiers and found their number wrong — fewer than expected for a faction holding its own ground.
source_quote: The number was wrong. Not collapse-of-the-faction wrong, but wrong enough that I counted them twice before I trusted what I was seeing.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Hartsch was exhausted, dirty, and bloodied in ways that suggested proximity to the fighting, not command distance from it.
source_quote: He had been in it, or near enough.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized the moment Hartsch stopped pretending to be in charge and asked them what to do next.
source_quote: Hartsch looked at us. 'What do we do next?' Four words. The authority transfer was complete.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia understood Hartsch had inherited a war he didn't fully understand and was losing forces he couldn't replace.
source_quote: Information he doesn't get to have. We built this; he inherited it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed Hartsch preferred to lose aggressively rather than win the way Romag had.
source_quote: Hartsch would rather lose aggressively than win the way that man had.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Hartsch listing the temple strengths and weaknesses without pride, like reading damage he'd already accepted.
source_quote: He had listed it the way a man lists damage he's already accepted, in order, without argument, like reading something he already knew.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch had sent the Broken Blades to attack without waiting for orders.
source_quote: I read it twice. Not because it was hard to read. Because I recognized it. 'I couldn't wait! I sent the Broken Blades to attack!'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia recognized the phrase 'I couldn't wait' as a sentence he had lived inside of himself.
source_quote: 'I couldn't wait' is a sentence I have lived inside of.

subject: The Broken Blades
fact: The fate of the Broken Blades is unspecified after Hartsch sent them to attack without orders.
source_quote: I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia suspected Hartsch had left because he couldn't wait to act — and he knew he had done the same thing himself.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: The Romag room
fact: The significance of the Romag room — where the apostles slept — and its connection to legacy and authority is left unexplored.
source_quote: Zephyr wanted the Romag room. The dead man's quarters, the one place in this building nobody would think to bother us.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed Hartsch handed the question of where the apostles slept off to him, and he handed deployment back to Hartsch.
source_quote: I watched Hartsch hand the whole question of where the apostles slept off to Zephyr, and Zephyr hand the question of deployment back to Hartsch.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed the war was running on its own momentum and didn't need them to keep burning.
source_quote: The war was running on its own momentum. Good. It didn't need us to keep burning.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed the soldiers were watching the Obsidian Edge, waiting to see if they would disappear on them again.
source_quote: They were watching us, the Obsidian Edge, waiting to see if we were about to disappear on them again.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the wraith's laughter as a response to the door sealing them in — and understood the wraith was counting on their entrapment.
source_quote: He said 'my servants' with obvious satisfaction. He was counting on it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith had been alone in the corridor for weeks, feasting on war leftovers, with nobody willing to call it by name or ask what it knew.
source_quote: It had been alone in this corridor for weeks, feasting on whatever the war left behind, with nobody willing to call it by name and ask it what it knew.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had stopped being a threat and become a conversational partner after being acknowledged.
source_quote: I'd given it an audience. The price of the audience was conversation, and conversation was exactly what I'd come for.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized that Hartsch’s final order — 'We will make a final stand' — was a surrender to fatalism disguised as resolve.
source_quote: We will make a final stand. It's time we got it to Temple.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch’s note — 'I couldn't wait!' — was a confession of the same impulse he himself had once acted on.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: The Greater Temple's true nature
fact: The identity of the 'people who are really in charge' in the Greater Temple remains unspecified.
source_quote: It's the people who are really in charge.

subject: The voice behind the door
fact: The identity of the voice behind the sealed Greater Temple door remains unknown.
source_quote: The Greater Temple is sealed until the battle is over. No one gets in, no one gets out.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr understood the wraith's promise — 'I can't wait till you come back here!' — was not a threat but a declaration of inevitability.
source_quote: He meant it warmly. The absolute confidence of something that has already decided the outcome and is merely permitting time to catch up.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed the leadership vacuum in the Earth Temple had become so acute that Hartsch was asking them — the architects of the war — what to do next.
source_quote: Hartsch looked at us. 'What do we do next?' Four words. The authority transfer was complete.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith’s specters were mostly Earth Temple forces — the very ones they had helped kill.
source_quote: I recognized the remnants of robes, the insignia, the general silhouette of people we had, in one way or another, contributed to killing.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the wraith had become a repository of information and memory from the war — the only one willing to talk.
source_quote: Information was information, and the wraith was currently the only entity in the room willing to talk.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed the soldiers had stopped looking to Hartsch and were instead looking to each other.
source_quote: I could see it register: the soldiers' eyes going to each other instead of to him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the wraith had stopped being a monster and become a mirror — reflecting back the consequences of their own actions.
source_quote: He counted them out. One, two, three. Four, five. Mostly Earth Temple forces. I recognized the remnants of robes, the insignia, the general silhouette of people we had, in one way or another, contributed to killing.
